title: Poverty Point Costly Signaling: Agent-Based Model and Analysis Code
description:
Agent-based model, analytical equilibrium analyses, GIS analyses, and figure-generation pipeline accompanying the manuscript on Poverty Point (ca. 1700-1100 BCE) as an adaptive costly-signaling system among Late Archaic mobile hunter-gatherers in the Lower Mississippi Valley. Implements coupled signaling rules under environmental uncertainty, multi-drainage shortfall buffering, and a Bayesian posterior predictive check against monument and exotic-goods records.

The release includes: (1) the core simulation under src/poverty_point/; (2) figure-generation scripts under scripts/figure_generation/; (3) analysis scripts (GIS-epsilon, sigma comparison, tier-3 extensions, distance decay) under scripts/analysis/; (4) verified reference materials and claims extractions under docs/references/; (5) the AA-formatted manuscript and JAS-formatted v2.0 manuscript with supplemental, including the source markdown and rendered docx; and (6) full reproducibility documentation in REPRODUCE.md and Makefile.

External datasets included by reference are public-domain: USGS Saucier (1994) Lower Mississippi Valley geomorphology and EPA Office of Research and Development Level IV ecoregions.
